result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but the Android gesture/home-indicator bar overlaps the bottom navigation icons, and the horizontally scrolling restaurant cards are cut off at the screen edge (acceptable for a carousel, but the overlap in the bottom bar is a real visual defect).

issues.description: The system gesture bar / home indicator overlaps the bottom navigation bar, striking through the search and bookmarks icons and making them look broken or partially obscured.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/inset handling (safe-area insets) so the bottom navigation icons render above the system gesture bar, or reduce icon area so they don't collide.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel (Trattoria Piccola) is cut off mid-word at the right edge, which can look like truncated text rather than an intentional scrollable carousel.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel peeks enough of the next card and add subtle scroll affordances (e.g., partial card visibility plus dots or edge fade) to signal scrollability.
